name: landmine press
description: Press the end of an angled barbell up and forward. The arc is friendly to the shoulder and trains pressing and trunk stability.
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell and hold the other end at your shoulder with both hands.
Stand with feet staggered and core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder under control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
